summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change does and the overall verdict. Markdown, no headings.

findings.description: Only verified findings with confidence >= 80, most severe first. Empty when nothing survives.

id.description: The id of a previous finding when this is the same issue, else an empty string.

title.description: One line, under 90 characters, no trailing period.

body.description: Markdown: the problem, the concrete failure scenario, and the fix. No headings.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file at head.

start_line.description: First line of the range in the head version (1-based).

end_line.description: Last line of the range in the head version; equal to start_line for one line.

rule.description: For rule findings: the file and the quoted rule text, e.g. AGENTS.md: "Never panic on user input." Empty string for plain bugs.

suggestion.description: Exact replacement text for lines start_line..end_line when the fix is small and certain, else null.

confidence.description: 0-100 from the rubric in the skill.
